claim: Raptor activated his Wildcard in gameweek 4 and is presenting his team selection.

quote: When you're wild carding as early as I am, it is difficult. You have to take some leaps of faith.

claim: Raptor says building this wildcard team early means he does not need a fifth 'insurance' defender because of how well his rotation pair covers each other.
quote: one of the benefits of me bench boosting early was I don't need five defenders

claim: After playing the Wildcard in GW4, Raptor states he will have three free transfers to use heading into GW5.
quote: I also have three free transfers, I should say. So, after I wild card and game five, I'm going to have three free transfers to use.

claim: Raptor's wildcard team is rated 93% by Fantasy Football Hub's team-rating tool.
quote: This team is rated at 93% according to Fantasy Football Hub.

claim: Raptor believes Calafiori, rested in the Champions League, will start every Premier League game for the foreseeable future, possibly with early subs rather than being left out.
quote: he was rested in the Champions League. I do think that he'll start every Premier League game for the foreseeable future

claim: Raptor sees strong attacking/goalscoring quality in the battle between Calafiori and Hincapie going forward, favouring Calafiori to start.
quote: I think there is a golfing quality especially going forward between Califur and Hen Capier

quote: Ezri Cona feels like ridiculous value. He's now started two games for Arsenal in a row and has been sensational in both games.

claim: Raptor flags that both Calafiori and Konsa could arguably have minutes problems at points this season.
quote: Califur and Conc both arguably could have minutes problems at points.

claim: Arsenal conceded just 0.22 xG against Napoli in the Champions League, which Raptor calls disgusting defensively.
quote: They conceded 0.22 xG. They are disgusting defensively.

claim: Raptor plans to rotate Vuskovic and Muharemović every week because Brighton and Leeds have a nice fixture rotation, discussed further in his prior day's video.
quote: Vushkovic and Muharramovic rotate beautifully. Brighton and Leeds have such a nice fixture rotation where every single week you can play one of the two of them.

claim: Raptor expects Brighton and Leeds to finish in the top 10 for expected goals conceded this season.
quote: they're two defenses I expect to finish in the top 10 for XGC this season

quote: Muhrimovic scored tonight against Chelsea in the cup and I do think in general he will be a player that does score a few goals a season.

claim: Muharemović is third overall for total defensive contributions, averaging 13 per game.
quote: Mukramovic is like third overall for total defensive contributions. He's averaging 13 per game.

quote: Vushkovic scored in game week three.

quote: I don't know if he's gonna be absolutely nailed every game when the Europa Conference League kicks in.

claim: Raptor believes Mendy's inconsistent minutes so far are a fitness issue and expects him to play 90 minutes most games once fit.
quote: Mendy's minutes haven't been perfect thus far but I think that's a fitness issue. Once he's fit, I expect him to play 90 most games.

claim: Mendy has hit the defensive-contribution threshold in two of three games and got 9 in the other before being subbed off around the 65th minute.
quote: he's hit defcon in two of the three games and the other game he got nine and he got subbed off in like the 65th minute

quote: The other three players that I'm super happy with and confident in is triple Chelsea attack. Rogers, Palmer, Ja Pedro.

claim: Palmer came off the bench in the Carabao Cup win over Leeds and scored a brace, including a penalty.
quote: Palmer gets a brace, including scoring a penalty, which is lovely to see.

quote: I think Palmer got man of the match and Rogers is like, Fine, I guess I'll give you the trophy.

quote: I could get Palmer back to Bruno Fernandez.

claim: Raptor is considering selling Rogers to bring in Gibbs-White at a later date.

claim: Raptor feels pretty good about captaining Palmer this gameweek.

claim: Raptor has locked in Haaland, calling him an easy include, and expects to captain him in a lot of upcoming weeks.
quote: And in a lot of the upcoming weeks, he'll be my captain.

quote: Ryer probably will be up there as one of the top scoring keepers, but there's never a huge gap between the 4.5s and David Riyot.
